lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: java-appium-override-server-url-without-host-validation
title: overrideServerUrl swaps HTTP client to a server-supplied URL without validating target host
summary: 'The executor''s overrideServerUrl method builds a new HTTP client for a URL taken from a remote
  server''s direct-connect response without checking where the host resolves. A malicious or compromised
  server can redirect subsequent traffic to loopback, link-local (cloud metadata), unspecified, or multicast
  addresses, enabling SSRF. The fix calls a safety validator before creating the new client.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-918
severity: medium
confidence: medium
languages:
- java
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 2b9cd442b9dbf56ccc6f1e83aeeb411c0ec230c9
  vulnerable_ref: 2b9cd442b9dbf56ccc6f1e83aeeb411c0ec230c9^
  patched_ref: 2b9cd442b9dbf56ccc6f1e83aeeb411c0ec230c9
  repository: https://github.com/appium/java-client
rule:
  message: 'Method $M replaces the HTTP client with one targeting $URL without first validating the resolved
    host

    (loopback/link-local/unspecified/multicast). Call DirectConnectUrlSafety.requireSafeOverrideTarget($URL)
    first.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: "$RET $M(URL $URL) {\n  ...\n  $F.createClient(<... $URL ...>);\n  ...\n}\n"
  - pattern-not: "$RET $M(URL $URL) {\n  ...\n  DirectConnectUrlSafety.requireSafeOverrideTarget($URL);\n\
      \  ...\n}\n"
  - metavariable-regex:
      metavariable: $M
      regex: (?i)^(override|set|switch|update).*(url|server|target).*$
fix:
  guidance: Before building a new HTTP client for a URL that came from the server (direct connect), validate
    it by resolving the host and rejecting loopback, link-local, unspecified and multicast addresses.
    Use DirectConnectUrlSafety.requireSafeOverrideTarget at the start of overrideServerUrl.
  example: "protected void overrideServerUrl(URL serverUrl) {\n    DirectConnectUrlSafety.requireSafeOverrideTarget(serverUrl);\n\
    \    HttpClient newClient = getHttpClientFactory().createClient(appiumClientConfig.baseUrl(serverUrl));\n\
    \    setPrivateFieldValue(HttpCommandExecutor.class, \"client\", newClient);\n}\n"
